messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel

message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Station name** | **Miami Central Station** (formerly Miami Intermodal Center) | | **Location** | 1 NE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33132 | | **Rail service** | Amtrak – *Silver Service* (Silver Meteor & Silver Star) | | **Pet policy** | Amtrak allows small pets (dogs, cats, birds, etc.) on most of its long‑distance trains, including the Silver Service. Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. A small fee (usually $25–$35 per pet) applies. Check Amtrak’s “Pets on Trains” page for the latest rules and to confirm availability on your specific route. | | **Station amenities for pets** | • Pet relief area (small fenced space) near the entrance.
• Water fountain for dogs.
• Convenient access to the platform for walking pets (no leash‑free policy, so keep your pet leashed). | | **Accessibility** | Fully ADA‑accessible with elevators, ramps, and accessible restrooms. | | **Contact** | Phone: (305) 284‑4000 (Amtrak Customer Service)
Website: https://www.amtrak.com/miami-central-station | ### Quick Tips 1. **Book Early** – Reserve your pet’s spot on the train at least 48 hours before departure. 2. **Carrier Size** – Must fit under the seat or in the luggage area; check Amtrak’s carrier dimensions. 3. **Health Documentation** – Bring a recent health certificate if traveling internationally or if required by Amtrak. 4. **Arrival Time** – Arrive at least 30 minutes early to allow time for pet checks and boarding. If you’re looking for a different type of pet‑friendly transit (e.g., bus or metro), let me know and I can help locate those options as well!
